site.intro: Alexandra designs and ships product ideas in Cursor — landings, Meta funnels, waitlists, apps, agents, and reusable craft. This page is her public portfolio of active workstreams.
site.howToNav: Jump via the table of contents. Each project: concept → website / funnel / Meta ads / mock-ups → code. General covers skills, agents, and reusable craft.

projects.name: Habit game
projects.oneLiner: Psychology-powered goal game — chic, streaky follow-through.
projects.summary: Name season and annual goals, check in daily, protect a streak, and play short “stuck games” when you drift.
